channel.title: Tuoi Tre News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Tuoi Tre News (tuoitrenews.vn)

item.title: Flights to evacuate stranded travellers in Middle East
item.description: Governments and airlines scrambled Tuesday to repatriate tens of thousands of travellers stranded in the Middle East following the eruption of a regional conflict sparked by Israel-US strikes on Iran.

item.title: Japan intensifies fight against workplace harassment
item.description: TOKYO -- Businesses in Japan are working to address increasingly complex demands and expectations related to workplace anti-harassment measures.

item.title: 20 million Vietnamese overweight or obese, many unaware of health risks: experts
item.description: About 20 million people in Vietnam are living with overweight or obesity, yet many fail to recognize the health risks or resort to extreme weight-loss measures instead of seeking proper medical care, experts said at a press briefing in Ho Chi Minh City on Wednesday.

item.title: Canadian Wood Vietnam expands technical support to strengthen local manufacturers
item.description: As Vietnam’s wood and furniture industry deepens its integration into global markets, industry groups say stronger cooperation and greater value creation are becoming increasingly critical.

item.title: Ho Chi Minh City expected to see off-season rains through Friday
item.description: Unseasonal rains will possibly affect about one-third of southern Vietnam, including Ho Chi Minh City, on Thursday and Friday as strong upper-level disturbances trigger late-afternoon and evening showers during the peak of the dry season.

item.title: Property ID cards expected to redefine Vietnam’s real estate market
item.description: Granting each property a unique identification code and publishing transaction data on a state-managed information system are poised to fundamentally reshape the rules of Vietnam’s real estate market in the years ahead.

item.title: Van Su double gives Vietnam 2-1 win over India in Women’s Asian Cup opener
item.description: Midfielder Ngan Thi Van Su scored twice as the Vietnamese women’s team beat India 2-1 in their opening match at the 2026 AFC Women’s Asian Cup in Australia on Wednesday.

item.title: Mining arm of Vietnam’s Masan Group poised to capitalize on tungsten price supercycle
item.description: Surging tungsten prices, driven by a widening global supply–demand imbalance, have established a new profit baseline for industry players. Amid intensifying competition among major economies to secure strategic material supplies, Masan High-Tech Materials (UpCom: MSR) is well-positioned to benefit from its strong market standing and competitive advantages across the global value chain.

item.title: Ho Chi Minh City reports 92 hospitalized in suspected ‘banh mi’ poisoning in Vung Tau
item.description: The number of people hospitalized following a suspected food poisoning incident linked to a street ‘banh mi’ stall in Vung Tau Ward, Ho Chi Minh City had risen to 92 as of Wednesday night.
